about: The LARRYD runtime's own config. Its ONLY link to the platform is HTTP to the addresses below, signed with the secret named here. No path, file, database or module of the platform is ever named.

platform.about: where the runtime calls the platform, per side (rnd = the stage, pf = live): wid alone (the core cleanup, the owner 2026-11-05: no agent has anything to do with cc, fs, lryllm or so; wid asks them as itself)

callers.about: the offices that may call the runtime's /api (X-Office), each checked with the secret

secret.name: runtime_link
secret.purpose: signs every call between the platform and the runtime; each side keeps its own copy in its own instance

intake.about: an agent the owner approved from LARRYD's review queue (one .larryd file) becomes a locker folder <folder>/<card key>/ (the host's place command)

makes.about: THE OUTSIDE HAND (core_engine/outside.py): what an agent may ask LARRYD to have made by a model on its list (Nano Banana 2, Seedance 2.5). a_day: how many files of each kind ONE member may have made by ONE agent in a day (UTC); the provider is paid per file with the platform's own key (its one home is the platform's vault; the runtime asks wid for it per errand and keeps no copy), so this is the bill's guard. The owner's numbers.

slots.about: Cloud Run (the LARRYD runtime design): the one runtime serves every caller; a call's key id names who called (slot-a, slot-b, proof), and the runtime calls back THAT caller at <host>/<office>, signed with its own key 'runtime-to-<caller>'. A caller with no host here is never called back (slot A has none until it runs the new platform; the laptop's proof has none: it cannot be reached).

access.about: THE SECOND GUARD (the owner: two guards, never one): every hire and run the platform signs carries the platform's own access decision for the member (FROST's grid) in this field; the runtime refuses any hire or run whose signed body does not carry the value that grants. The field's name is the hire-rights lane's (provisional until it is named).

lockers.about: EACH CALLER ITS OWN LOCKER (the owner 2026-11-22: "there should be zero agents that are on a and b at the same fucking time"): an agent's locker row and folder are its caller's, so a manifest changed for one platform never changes another's hashes. first: the caller whose locker is the one held before 2026-11-22, its rows (caller '') and folders exactly where they were (on the lockers bucket <key>/...); every other caller's is its own copy, rows under its name, folders in <locker>.<caller>/ beside it (on the bucket <caller>/<key>/...). The locker in place (LARRYD_INTERNAL=1 and LARRYD_LOCKER, the one internal locker) stays one locker for every caller, as before.

pages.about: THE PAGES' OWN ADDRESS of each caller (the owner, 2026-10-25, THE LARRY DATA FABRIC's DOWNLOAD): where its members open their pages, so a link the runtime builds for a page (DA-M's own download of a file) is an https address of that very host, in a new tab (the platform's view gate takes nothing else). A caller with none here gets no such link.
